tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi khrid kyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa nā ro zhabs kyi zhal gyi lung bzang po zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

zab lam nā ro'i chos drug gi khrid kyi lag len gsal bar bshad pa nā ro zhabs kyi zhal gyi lung bzang po zhes bya ba/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs tha mi dad pa la gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo// bde stong zung 'jug mchog gi gtum mo e waṃ rang bzhin lhun grub dngos// gcig dang du ma'i mthar 'dzin spangs kyang rnam kun mchog ldan 'od gsal sku// sgra dang sgra min brjod pa rnam bral gzhom med nā da'i rang bzhin dbyangs// rnam dag 'ja' tshon sgyu ma'i gar mkhan yan lag bdun ldan la phyag 'tshal// nyi zla'i 'pho ba srog rtsol zag bcas khams// dhū tir sgra gcan sreg za'i za phod kyis// sbyangs te zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa// grub chen nā ro'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal// rang bzhin rnam dag dngos po'i gnas lugs gang*// bde stong zung 'jug lam gyi byed bcings gis// skal ldan dag pa'i sa la rtag 'god pa// brgyud pa'i bshes gnyen rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// rgyal ba yan lag bdun ldan khyod ni 'gro blo'i mkha' la sgyu ma'i gar// ji ltar chu snod dwangs pa rnams su ri bong 'dzin pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar// snyigs dus gdul bya'i mig gi lam du dam pa mchog gi tshul bzung ba// rtsa ba'i bla ma bi da ra ṇa sam+pan+na rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag snying pad+mor rtag tu mchod// gsang chen rdo rje'i theg mchog rgyud rnams su// lan gcig min par yang yang gsungs pa yi// zab don rdzogs pa'i rim pa ches zab pa// nā ro zhabs kyi bzhed srol bdud rtsi'i dpyid// lho brag mar ston chen por gang bab pa// bod 'dir 'ga' 'ga' mchis pa'i snying po rnams// tshig nyung don tshang 'gag don gnad bsdus pa// kho bos bshad kyi gzur gnas skal pa can// don gnyer mchis na rna ba blags te nyon// gal te nyes brgya'i khur gyis rab non pa'i// phrag dog brlang po'i blo can yod srid na// rab rib can gyi mig sngar skra shad dag

/rang nyid kho na'i skyon yin gzhan du ci// 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos ni zab lam nā ro'i chos drug tu grags pa nyid yin la/ de la'ang gnyis/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ de las byung ba'i gdams pa'o/ dang po bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa la'ang gnyis/ bka' bab nyams kyi brgyud pa dang*/ rtogs pa byin rlabs don gyi brgyud pa'o// dang po bka' bab nyams kyi brgyud pa ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa mi'i srid pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i til+li shes rab bzang po zhes bya ba de nyid la/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ 'phags mchog klu sgrub/ ma taṃ gi pa rnams las rim lnga dang*/ 'pho ba dang*/ grong 'jug gi bka' bab/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ lū hi pa/ ḍiṅgi pa rnams las phyag rgya chen po'i bka' bab/ su ma ti kun tu bzang mo/ kar+ṇa ri pa rnams las gtum mo dang bar do'i bka' bab/ ḍoṃ bhi pa/ bi na sa/ lwa ba pa/ in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba la sogs pa rnams las 'od gsal dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ sgyu lus kyi bka' bab/ gnyis pa rtogs pa byin rlabs don gyi brgyud pa ni/ grub chen til+li pa nyid la khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gis dngos su rjes su bzung zhing dbang dang gdams pa rjes su bstan pa yin no// grub chen 'di dag gis gdams pa ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs par bstsal ba ni grub pa'i dbang phyug nā ro paṇa chen dzñā na sid+dhi yin la/ 'dis gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa ma lus pa bstsal te de nyid kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ba ni lho brag mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros yin la/ de nas rim pa bzhin mi la bzhad pa rdo rje/ dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu/ 'gro mgon rdo rje rgyal po/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rat+na shrī/ dbon bsod nams grags pa/ gcung rdo rje grags pa/ thog kha ba rin chen seng ge/ mtshams bcad pa grags pa bsod nams/

bcu gnyis rdo rje rin chen/ nyer brgyad pa rdo rje rgyal po/ 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po/ bshes gnyen don grub rgyal po/ ldong la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang rgyal mtshan/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ wang rin chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rgyal dbang kun dga' rin chen/ mnyam med rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po/ paṇa chen dpal gyi rgya mtsho/ rje btsun dam pa chos rgyal phun tshogs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang bi da ra ṇa sam+pan+na/ de nyid kyis bdag chos kyi grags pa la bstsal ba yin la/ rjes su zhal bskangs pa/ dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal/ dkon mchog phrin las bzang po/ phrin las don grub chos rgyal/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul/ lho chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin pad+ma'i rgyal mtshan/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ khri chen chos dbang blo gros| dkon mchog chos nyid nor bu/ dkon mchog thugs rje'i nyi ma/ o rgyan nus ldan rdo rje/ rin chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun dkon mchog chos skyabs/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi blo gros/ thub bstan zhi ba'i blo gros/ brgyud pa de rnams kyang rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du mi bar khyis ma chod/ dam nyams dang 'dres khyer gyi sad ma phog /rang bzo dang gya tshom gyi lhad ma zhugs/ thal phyir dang khyab sogs rtog ge 'khrul ba phyogs gcig pa'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi 'khrul ba mgo 'khor yin rlom gyi rnam bshad skyo sngogs dang skyar 'byin brlang pos kun nas bslangs pa'i blos rgyal ba'i gsung rab dri ma med pa'i tshig don rnams rang blo 'khrul ba'i lung rgyab tu 'dren zhing*/ 'khyog po'i rnam grangs du ma'i gtan tshig ltar snang nye tshe ba'i rnam bshad/ de'ang don med don log ngan g.yo brtse bral thos rtsod lhur len te mtshan nyid drug dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos kyi byed pos deng sang dbus gtsang gi ljongs gang ba la bstan pa dang*/

de 'dzin bshes gnyen rnam dag tu khas len pa'i gyi na ba dag gi ngag gi lam du ma drangs pa'i rdo rje'i tshig brling po rnams brgyud pa rnam dag de rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes pas nyams rtogs dpyis phyin pa brnyes pa dag gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i snying po'i bstan pa dam pa 'di dag gi gdams pa zab cing rgya che ba tshong dus kyi 'o ma ltar ma song ba kho na nyid do// gnyis pa brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa ni paṇa chen nā ro pa chen po dang*/ mnga' bdag mar pa lo tsā gnyis kyis dpal me tog mdangs 'phrog gi dgon par bsgyur ba'i rim lnga bsdus pa las| dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// zhes gsungs pa nyid yin te/ de la'ang gsum/ gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs/ lam nyams su blang tshul| 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa dang gsum mo// dang po gzhi dngos po'i gnas lugs bshad pa la gnyis/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs/ sems dngos pa'i gnas lugs gnyis so| |dang po lus dngos po'i gnas lugs la'ang bzhi/ lus kyi gnas lugs/ rtsa'i gnas lugs/ rlung gi gnas lugs/ thig le'i gnas lugs rnams so// dang po lus kyi gnas lugs ni/ ji skad du/ lus ni byang chub rnam pa lnga// zhes gsungs te/ rnam 'byor pa skye ba snga ma'i lus kyi phung khams skye mched 'byung ba ye shes dang bcas pa thim ste 'od gsal du 'jug pa ni chos nyid stong pa nyid las mngon par byang chub pa/ de nas ma'i mngal du khu khrag dkar dmar gyi dbus su zhugs pa ni gdan nyi zla las mngon par byang chub pa/ khu khrag 'dres pa'i tshe gong bu rjes su nga ro'i rnam par gnas pa ni gsung yig 'bru las mngon par byang chub pa/ gong bu las gzugs kyi rnam pa stod smad sbom zhing sked pa phra ba'i rnam pa can ni thugs phyag mtshan las mngon par byang chub pa/ de nas lus yongs su rdzogs te skye ba ni sku yongs su rdzogs pa las mngon par byang chub pa yin no// yang na pha'i khu ba dkar po zla ba'i rang bzhin la thig le brgyad brgyad bcu drug

/de cha gnyis rdzogs pa las so gnyis dbyangs yig phrag gnyis kyi rang bzhin can mtshan so gnyis kyi ngo bo zla ba me long ye shes las byang chub pa/ ma'i khu ba khrag gi rang bzhin can rdul mun snying stobs kyi byed pas bzhi bcu pa phrag gnyis las brgyad cu gsal byed bzhi bcu pa phrag gnyis kyi rang bzhin can dpe byad brgyad cu'i ngo bo nyi ma mnyam nyid ye shes las byang chub pa/ de dag gi bar du dri za'i rnam shes zhugs shing gnas pa na dbyibs mi 'dra ba du mar las rlung gi byed pas gnas pa ni sa bon dang phyag mtshan gyi rnam par snang ba sor rtog ye shes las byang chub pa/ rnam shes khu khrag dang bcas pa gcig tu gyur pa las mer mer po la sogs pa'i rnam par gnas pa bya grub ye shes las byang chub pa/ mngal du lus yongs su rdzogs pa ni sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos dbyings ye shes las byang chub pa'o// yang na rnal 'byor pa'i lus snga ma 'chi ba 'od gsal du zhugs pa chos sku/ de las ma'i mngal du lus yongs su rdzogs pa longs sku/ de nyid zla ba bcu nas btsa' ba sprul pa'i skur bzhed pa sogs mang du gsungs so// gnyis pa rtsa'i gnas lugs ni/ rgyas par na rdo rje'i lus la rtsa sa ya phrag bcu gsum/ de las bsdus na bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi/ de'ang bsdu na stong phrag bdun cu rtsa bzhi/ de'ang bsdu na 'khor lo bco brgyad dang rtsa 'dab brgya dang bco brgyad/ de'ang bsdu na 'khor lo lnga'i rtsa 'dab brgya dang lnga bcu nga gnyis/ de'ang bsdu na 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa 'dab brgya dang nyi shu ste/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo chu tshod sum cu rtsa gnyis snyoms 'jug gi gnas skabs te 'pho ba'i las skyed par byed/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo 'pho ba bcu drug pa nying 'khrul gyi gnas skabs te rmi lam skyed par byed/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo thun phran brgyad pa gnyid 'thug gi gnas skabs te gti mug skyed par byed/

lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi pa sad pa'i gnas skabs te 'du byed skyed par byed/ de'ang bsdu na rtsa sum cu rtsa bdun/ de'ang bsdu na nus pa can gyi rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de'ang bsdu na yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa nyer bzhi/ de'ang bsdu na rtsa'i gtso bo dbu rkyang ro gsum/ de'ang bsdu na rtsa a wa dhū ti rtsa mdud sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis brgyan pa nyid yin no// gsum pa rlung gi gnas lugs ni/ rgyas par na rtsa'i grangs dang mnyam la/ bsdu na nyin zhag phrugs gcig la rlung nyi khri chig stong dang drug brgya/ de'ang bsdu na 'pho chen bcu gnyis/ de'ang bsdu na rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang yan lag gi rlung lngar 'dus te| de'ang rtsa ba'i rlung lnga ni/ thur ser nam mkha'i rlung gsang gnas su gnas/ bde ba skyed cing 'og sgo gnyis 'byed 'dzum dang bshang gci 'phen sdom gyi las byed/ me mnyam sa'i rlung lte bar gnas/ drod skyed cing zas 'ju ba'i las byed/ srog 'dzin chu'i rlung snying gar gnas/ srog 'dzin cing dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba'i las byed/ gyen rgyu me'i rlung mgrin par gnas| bza' btung mid pa dang mchil snabs 'dor ba dang smra dgod kyi las byed/ khyab byed rlung gi rlung spyi bo dang sor tshigs rnams su gnas/ kun la khyab cing 'gro 'dug dang 'gul bskyod kyi las byed do// yan lag gi rlung lnga ni/ me mnyam gyi yan lag rgyu ba zhes bya ba mig gi dbang rten zar ma'i me tog lta bu la gnas/ gzugs mthong ba'i las byed/ srog 'dzin gyi yan lag rnam par rgyu ba rna ba'i dbang rten gro ga gcus pa lta bu la gnas/ sgra thos pa'i las byed/ khyab byed kyi yan lag yang dag par rgyu ba sna'i dbang rten zangs kyi mo khab gshibs pa lta bu la gnas/ dri tshor ba'i las byed/ gyen rgyu'i yan lag rab tu rgyu ba lce'i dbang rten zla ba phyed pa lta bu la gnas/ ro myong ba'i las byed/

thur sel gyi yan lag shin tu rgyu ba lus kyi dbang rten bya reg na bde ba'i pags pa lta bu pags pa spyi khyab dang bye brag gsang bar gnas/ bde ba skyed cing reg bya tshor ba'i las byed do// de ltar rlung thams cad rlung bcu po 'di la ma 'dus pa med la/ de'ang snying ga'i srog gi rlung las gyes pa'i sna bug gi rlung ni phyir rgyu ba'i tshe nyon mongs kyi rtog pa skyed pas rtsol ba zhes bya la| nang du gnas pa'i tshe dpal dang tshe bsod skyed pas srog ces bya/ yang na sna bug g.yas nas rgyu ba'i tshe nyon mongs pa skyed cing don mi 'grub pas rtsol ba/ sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba'i tshe bde stong skyed cing don 'grub pas srog /sna bug mnyam rgyu'i tshe ye shes kyi rlung zhes btang snyoms pa ste 'chi ba ster zhing gdams pa'i gnad dang mi ldan na don med pa nyid yin no| |yang 'jug pas don 'grub/ dbyung bas don mi 'grub/ gnas pa btang snyoms so// de dag rgyud sde spyi'i lugs yin la/ dus kyi 'khor lor ni sna bug gnyis ka'i rlung la srog ces bya zhing de nyid byed bcing gis nyams su blang ba la rtsol ba zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa thig le'i gnas lugs ni/ rgyas par rtsa'i grangs dang mnyam la/ bsdu na sum cu rtsa bdun/ de'ang bsdu na sum cu rtsa gnyis/ de'ang bsdu na nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ de'ang bsdu na bcu drug /de'ang bsdu na khams dgu/ de'ang bsdus pas thig le bzhi ste/ spyi bor haṃ gi rnam pa dkar po bde ba skyed byed ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon/ mgrin par oṃ gyi rnam pa dmar po gsal ba skyed byed longs sku'i sa bon/ snying gar hūm̐ gi rnam pa sngon po mi rtog pa skyed byed chos sku'i sa bon/ lte bar aṃ gi rnam pa dmar po bde drod skyed byed sprul sku'i sa bon can no// de'ang bsdu na spyi bor dkar cha'i dwangs ma haṃ gi rnam pa dang*/ lte bar dmar cha'i dwangs ma a thung gi rnam pa can e waṃ bde stong thabs shes kyi rang bzhin can la ma 'dus pa med la/

gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa'i lus la 'pho ba dang*/ mi 'pho ba dang*/ g.yo ba dang*/ mi g.yo ba la sogs pa'i thig le dpag tu med pa gnas so// gnyis pa sems dngos po'i gnas lugs ni/ dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud kyi gsang ba'i gdan gyi rab tu phye ba gnyis par| shel dang mtshungs pa dag pa'i sems// sems la skyon dang yon tan med// yul rnams dang ni phrad pa yis// srid pa'i skyon gyis gos pa yin// zhes dang*/ de nyid las/ rtag tu rnam shes nam mkha' 'dra// kha dog med bya thams cad mtshon// mi ldan lus can ldan pa de// gzugs med pa ni kun gyi gzugs// de bzhin thung ngu ring po min// sems kyi de kho na nyid kyis// dngos med rdzu 'phrul 'grub par 'gyur// mtshan nyid med pa'i sems kyis ni// mtshan nyid thams cad ster ba'o// dngos po med pa bsgoms pa yis// sgom pa dag ni kun mtshon par// zhes sogs gsungs pas/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ nam mkha' bzhin du 'gyur ba med pa/ gsal stong zung du 'jug pa/ rang bzhin rnam pa dang bcas pa'i tshul dang*/ gtso bo kun gzhi rags pa dbang shes dang nyon yid/ phra ba sems byung nga gcig dang kun rtog brgyad cu/ shin tu phra ba snang mched thob gsum la sogs pa 'char ba dang 'gag pa'i tshul rnams shes dgos la/ gzhan yang sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras sogs sngags kyi lam rnams la go ba chags par bya dgos la/ phar phyin theg pa'i lta ba rang gzhan gyi stong lugs sogs kyi rnam gzhag ni 'dir gal mi che'o/// / *༈ */gnyis pa lam nyams su blang ba'i rim pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro la'ang gnyis/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o// dang po thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba/ de nyid mi rtag cing 'chi ba/ dkar nag rgyu 'bras la yid ches par bya ba/

'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kyis yid 'byung ba rnams so// gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la'ang bzhi/ rgyud snod rung du dgod pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sdig sgrib sbyong byed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams so// de ltar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnams ni kho bos bgyis pa'i lnga ldan rdo rje'i tshig rkang ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ smin byed kyi dbang dang grol byed kyi gdams pa'o// dang po smin byed kyi dbang ni/ chos drug 'di bde dgyes gsang gsum dus 'khor sogs bla med kyi rgyud thams cad kyi rdzogs rim du ma gsungs pa med pas rgyud sde de dag thams cad kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs pa gang byas kyang 'dra bar mchis shing*/ khyad par brgyud pa 'di nyid kyi phyag bzhes la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bden gnyis zhal gyi dbang nges par mdzad pas de dag gi dbang sta gon dang 'brel zhing dbang gi go don 'phrod nges su bskur ba gal che bas des chog des 'ong bskur thob kyi ming tsam la chags zhen mi bya bar mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig skabs 'dir gal che'o// gnyis pa grol ba'i lam la gnyis/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim mo// dang po ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas/ oṃ swa bhā wa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥdang*/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥgasum gyis sbyangs pas gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam/ de'i ngang las hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur bla bre mda'i dra ba/ de'i phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo chen po'i dbus su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa| gdengs ka che ba yar bstan pa/ phyi sngo nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/

a las zla ba nya gang ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan la baṃ chen bsnol ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid bam̐ yig dmar po 'od 'bar ba las rdo rje gri gug lte bar bam̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las nam mkha' la dar dmar po phyar ba ltar rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ rtsa zhal spyan gsum khro chags 'dres pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal nag po ngur sgra sgrog pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan can skra grol ba/ thod pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi do shal dang rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga 'chang ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar bsnams pa/ gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsgrengs pa/ gcer mo khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ nu ma langs pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs khams gsum gyi dbyings su bsgyur ba/ rang lus las 'bar ba'i me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de la go cha bgo ba ni/ de'i lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ mgrin par hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral bar hriṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha thams cad kyang zhal gcig /phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ rgyan chas phag mo ltar gsal gdab bo// ye shes pa dgug cing byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i gsang gnas su chos 'byung dmar po'i lte bar hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

de dag gi sku las rnal 'byor ma'i sku dpag tu med pa spros pa rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus la bde ba dang nus pa bskyed| gsung las ā li kā li dmar po spros rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag la mthu dang nus pa bskyed/ thugs las byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun bab rang gi snying gar thim pas bde stong gi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ mthar rnal 'byor ma de nyid rang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la bskyed rim ci nus su bsgom/ des ngal na dag pa dran pa ni/ sku ni chos thams cad du ma ro gcig pa nyon mongs kyi rtog pa dbyings su zhi bas rtsa zhal khro chags 'dres pa/ chos sku 'gyur ba med pas rna ltag tu phag zhal/ ye shes dbyings su rgyas pas sems can gyi don mdzad pas dbu skra phyed bcings rgyab tu grol ba/ dus gsum mkhyen phyir spyan gsum/ bdud bzhi rtsad nas gcod pas mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ thabs shes zung du 'jug pas phyag gnyis ma/ gdug pa can zil gyis gnon pas g.yas gri gug /rtog med kyi zas la rol bas g.yon thod khrag /yab he ru ka sbas pa'i tshul gyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /dug lnga dag pas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan/ 'du byed lnga bcu rtsa gcig dag pas thod pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi do shal/ phar phyin drug rdzogs pa'i rus pa'i phyag rgya lnga/ chos nyid don dam pa'i rol ba baṃ chen/ nyon mongs pa'i mun pa 'joms pa nyi ma/ 'khor ba'i tsha gdung sel ba zla ba/ 'khor ba'i skyon spangs kyang 'khor ba blos mi gtong bas pad+ma'i gdan/ nyon mongs kyi rtog pa bsregs pas rang 'od kyi me/ mdor na rang gi sems kyi snang phyogs lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bu/ stong phyogs 'od gsal chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du mos pa'i dag pa dran par bya'o// des kyang ngal na/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes rang sems gdod nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa la yin pa'i nga rgyal ches brtan par bya'o// de nas bzlas pa ni/

rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i gsang gnas sam/ lte bar chos 'byung dmar po me'i 'khor lo lta bu'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar nyi ma'i dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mthar sngags phreng gis g.yon du bskor ba/ sngags bzlas pa'i tshe gdan sa bon dang bcas pa mi 'gul bar sngags phreng g.yon skor du drag la myur bar 'khor bar bsams pas/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ ci nus bzlas/ thun mthar/ oṃ badz+ra bā rā hī ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yis 'khor lo sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe sa bon bam̐ las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad 'od du byas pa rang la bstim/ rang lus stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba bam̐ la thim/ bam̐ yig khog pa mgo bo zla tshes thig le nā da la bsdus te nā da'ang 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag /ldang ba'i tshe slar yang rang nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gyur par bsam pa'i ngang nas spyod lam la 'jug go// / ༈ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim la gnyis/ rtsa ba'i chos bzhi dang yan lag gi chos gnyis/ dang po ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la brten nas 'pho ba'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma sbyong zhing 'dod chags lam du byed pa gtum mo lam gyi gzhung shing*/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor la brten nas sems rang bzhin gyis rmongs pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma sbyong zhing gti mug lam du byed pa 'od gsal lam gyi snying po/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la brten nas nying 'khrul rmi lam gyi gnas skabs kyi dri ma sbyong zhing zhe sdang lam du byed pa rmi lam lam gyi tshod 'dzin/

spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo la brten nas sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma sbyong zhing nga rgyal dang phrag dog lam du byed pa sgyu lus lam gyi gzhi ma rnams so// dang po ni/ chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur las// sems kyi gnas thabs lta ba'i gdeng*// lus kyi gnas thabs sgom pa'i gnad/ */phyi ni sgyu ma lha yi sku/ */nang na rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi/ */'og na a shad tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ */steng na haṃ yig rnam pa can/ */steng 'og rlung gi 'khor lo'i dbyibs/ */ srog rtsol bum can nyams len gyis// bar na bde stong gsal ba'i nyams// ming yang gtum mo'i gdams pa zer// rlung gnad du chud dam lo tsā ba// chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur 'di rnams/ rje mar pa'i rnam thar dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas mdzad par 'di rnams dang zur mi 'dra ba tsam 'dug na'ang*/ gtsang smyon pas mdzad pa dang sprul sku ngag dbang kun blos mdzad pa gnyis zhal mthun par 'di ltar 'byung zhing*/ chos drug gi dmigs rim dang yang 'di nyid mthun par snang bas de ltar bris pa yin no// zhes gsungs pa ste/ 'di nyams su blang ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro sbyang ba rnam gsum/ dngos gzhi nyams len rnam gsum/ rjes yan lag rnam gsum mo// dang po la gsum/ rtsa sbyang ba/ rlung sbyang ba/ thig le sbyang ba'o// dang po lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i khong pa'i nang du rtsa dbu ma sba lcag gam/ mda' smyug sbom pa tsam gyi phyi sngo ba/ nang dmar ba'am/ sngon po 'ba' zhig gam/ dmar po 'ba' zhig pa/ yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po dang g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po gnyis dbu ma las cung zad phra ba yar sne klad rgya'i steng nas thur du gug pa sna bug gnyis la zug pa/ mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi tsam nas dbu ma la yi ge cha'i dbyibs ltar zug pa/

de gsum ga ya yo med pa/ drang ba/ kha dog dwangs pa/ phyi nang gsal ba/ nang stong pa ste mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa/ rtsa de gsum gyi bar mda' smyug tsam gyis ma thug par gsal gdab/ de'i rjes lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ de'ang dbu ma las brgyad phyogs mtshams su gyes pa/ de las gnyis gnyis gyes pas bcu drug /de las gnyis gnyis gyes pas so gnyis/ de las gnyis gnyis gyes pas drug cu rtsa bzhi pa kha dog dmar po/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad dbu ma las phyogs mtshams brgyad du so sor gyes pa kha dog dkar po/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug dbu ma nas phyogs mtshams brgyad dang de las gnyis gnyis gyes pas bcu drug kha dog dmar po/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo smin mtshams kyi thad tsam gyi nang du rtsa 'dab so gnyis dbu ma nas phyogs mtshams su brgyad gyes pa/ de las gnyis gnyis gyes pas bcu drug /de las gnyis gnyis gyes pas so gnyis rnams kha dog ljang gu/ de'ang lte ba dang mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor gnyis gdugs kyi 'gyogs ltar cung zad steng du phyogs pa/ spyi bo dang snying ga'i rtsa 'khor gnyis gdugs kyi rtsibs ltar 'og tu cung zad phyogs pa/ rtsa 'khor de rnams kyi gyes mtshams thams cad mdud pa'i rnam pa can/ so so'i rtse mo rnams ni grangs med du gyes nas lus kyi stod smad bar gsum gyi ba spu'i khung bu thams cad du zug pa lus thams cad rtsa'i dra mig shigs se ba/ rtsa'i gtso mo gsum ma gtogs pa'i rtsa gzhan rnams rlung ma bcug pa'i dus lug rjud kyi rgyu ma ltar snyom hrid de bar bsam/ de ltar rtsa 'khor rnams la gsal snang ma thon bar du 'di nyid la 'bad nas bsgom pa gal che'o// chos drug gi yig cha la lar stong ra sgom pa'i rim pa 'ga' zhig so sor gsungs kyang 'dir phyi lha sku/ nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa thams cad stong gsal 'dzin med du bsgoms pas stong ra thams cad 'du bar bzhed pa yin no// gnyis pa rlung sbyang ba ni/

lus rnam snang gi chos bdun gyi steng nas rlung mnyam rgyu 'dug na des 'ong la/ mi 'dug na rlung yon po srong ba'i 'khrul 'khor rlung rgyu ba ngos 'og tu bcug la bkag /mi rgyu ba ngos nas lan mang du bus la mnyam rgyu byung ma thag /lag g.yon rdo rje khu tshur g.yas pa'i gru 'og tu bcug /sna bug g.yas nas rlung khengs pa brngub/ lag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mos sna bug g.yas pa bkag la g.yon nas drag la ring ba gcig 'bud/ yang gong ltar g.yas nas brngubs la g.yon du drag la thung ba gcig /yang gong ltar la g.yon nas 'jam la ring ba gcig rnams 'bud| de'i rjes phyag rgya g.yas g.yon bsgyur la/ g.yon nas brngubs la g.yas nas gong ltar lan gsum 'bud/ de'i rjes lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur pus steng so sor bzhag nas rlung sna bug gnyis ka nas gong ltar lan gsum 'bud/ rlung rngub 'bud kyi tshe rlung dmigs sems gsum gcig tu dril la phyogs der gtad cing phar bus pa'i tshe nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sangs sangs dag par bsam mo// de ltar 'bud pa dgu phrugs 'di snod mi gtsang ba bkru bshal byas pa dang 'dra bas snga thun dang po'i 'gor bya ba ma gtogs thun thams cad kyi 'gor mi bya'o// de'i rjes bum can 'dzin pa la'ang thun mong dang khyad par ba gnyis las/ thun mong ba'i bum can ni/ brngub dang dgang dang gzhil ba dang*// mda' ltar 'phang dang rnam pa bzhi// zhes gsungs pas/ brngub pa ni lus gnad gong ltar la rdo rje'i khu tshur pus steng bzhag /mgrin pa cung zad dgu bas sna bug gnyis ka nas rlung 'jam la ring zhing sgra med par rdzogs par brngubs pa/ dgang ba ni khengs par brngubs zin nas mchil ma dang bcas te lte 'og tu hril gyis bskyur la mnan nas drod cung zad phebs pa dang rgyab rlung cung zad gcig 'dren la kha sbyor lte 'og tu mnan/ steng rlung cung zad ma goms bar du rgyab rlung cung zad las mang bar mi 'then/

goms nas rgyu zhabs mi 'gul bar 'og rlung rdzogs par drangs la kha sbyor du mnan no// gzhil ba ni rlung thub thad du bzung la mi thub snyam byed na lus gcu zhing mnan/ des kyang mi thub na cung zad phyir btang nas rngub chung byas la g.yas g.yon dbus gsum du dal gyis gcud cing dgang ngo// 'dir mi thub pa'i tshe rlung cung zad btang nas rngub chung mi byed par bzhin ras sogs shin tu dmar por song zhing mi thub kyang nan gyis bzung na rlung thag ring ba ltar re zhig 'gyur yang lus kyi zungs la ches gnod cing*/ khyad par du yon tan skye ba'i gegs dang rlung gi gegs su 'gyur ba sogs skyon mang bar gsungs so// de ltar dgang zhing gzhil ba'i tshe rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi rtsa phran dang bcas pa lug rjud kyi rgyu ma phus btab pa ltar ther ther khengs par bsam mo// mda' ltar 'phang ba ni thun 'gor lan re tsam du rlung gtong ba'i tshe ltag pa cung zad dgye la sna bug gnyis nas dal bus btang ba'i rlung 'jug drag la thung bar bus pas rlung dbu ma'i yar sne tshangs bug tu sngo phyur phyur song bar bsam/ 'di lan mang na 'pho nyen che'o// de'i rjes dus kun tu rlung tshur rngub pa dang gtong ba'i tshe sgra med dal bus bya zhing*/ de'ang rlung bus ma thag brngubs nas 'dzin na rlung bus pa'i rting pa cung zad tsam ma rdzogs pa'i tshe tshur brngubs la gong ltar 'dzin/ de yang dbyung ba'i tshe sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dag par bsam| rngub pa'i tshe dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs thams cad rlung gi rnam par ro rkyang gi lam nas brgyud dbu ma rtsa 'khor dang bcas pa chil chil gang bar bsam/ rlung phyir bus pa'i tshe phyi'i nam mkha' gsal stong dang nang gi sems nyid gsal stong bsre zhing*/ phyi 'byung ba'i rlung dang nang srog rtsol gyi rlung bsres par bsams te/ 'jig rten gsum gyi bla ma dpal ldan 'bri gung pas/

rlung phyi nang bsre ba stong pa'i gnad// ces gsungs so// de ltar bum pa can la goms pa'i tshad ni lag pa pus mo gnyis dang dpral bar reg cing se gol brdabs pa rnams lan re rer rtsis la brgya phrag gcig bum can rab/ brgyad cu 'bring*/ lnga bcu thub pa tha mar gsungs la/ de dag brgya phrag thub pa'ang gsar bu pa la dgongs pa yin gyi rlung la ches goms pa ni de ltar min no// khyad par ba'i bum can ni/ mgon po 'bri gung pas/ rlung mi 'dzin pa lhug par 'jog pa gnad zab ces gsungs pa nyams su blang ba ni rgyu zhabs kyi phyi'i pags pa mi 'gul bar lte 'og tu cung zad mnan/ lte 'og rtsa gsum 'dus mdor a yig dngul chu lus kyi tsha grang dang bstun pa'i dmigs pa sum khrid ltar spo/ lta bu rlung sems 'dus pa'i ngo bo la sems gtad de rlung rngub 'bud mi bya zhing lus sems ye mi sgrim par lhod kyis glod la rlung sems gnyis ka lte ba'i a la ma yeng bar gtad do// 'di shin tu zab ste/ mgon po 'bri gung pa chen pos/ kha sna'i rlung grang ba'i rang bzhin yin la brngubs pas grang ba 'jug /dgang ba'i rlung ngos ma zin par btsir bas mdzer 'gyur/ gzhil ba'ang gong dang 'dra/ mda' ltar 'phang zhing thabs lam la rtsol ba drag po byas pas 'pho bar 'gro ba ma shes pa yin gsungs/ des na gtum mo sogs dmigs bsal gyi tshe sbyor ba bzhi ldan snga ma ltar bya/ dus kun tu rlung gnad phyi ma nyid nyams su blang ba yon tan myur la gegs nyung ba yin no// gsum pa thig le sbyang ba ni/ dbu ma nas rtsa gcig gyes pa smin mtshams su zug pa'i sne rtsa sbug zur gsum pa'i nang du rlung sems kyi ngo bo thig le dkar 'tsher snum pa sran ma 'bring po tsam zhig gsal btab/ de gsal ba na rlung rngub pa'i tshe lcags sbubs su sran ma bsgril ba ltar seng sgra dang bcas dbu mar zhugs nas spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su slebs/

rlung bzung ba'i tshe der gnas pa la rlung sems gzung*/ de la goms pas rlung sems der gnas pa las gzhan du mi 'pho na/ mgrin pa snying ga lte ba gsang gnas rnams su'ang rim gyis sbyang*/ de la goms nas gnas rnams su rlung khug lnga'am bdun te rim gyis sbyangs shing rlung 'bud pa'i tshe smin mtshams nyid du gnas par bsam mo// de ltar sbyang ba gsum gyi gegs sel dang bogs 'don lus sbyong gi 'khrul 'khor ni gsum/ phyi lus kyi yan lag lnga'i rtsa sbyang ba/ nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa mdud dgrol ba/ de dag gi tshe rlung sems zin nas bde drod 'bar tshe lus rngul na de nyid dgram pa dang gsum mo// dang po yan lag lnga sbyong ni// lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun la// rdo rje'i khu tshur pus steng bsgreng*// sbyor bzhi rlung gi gnad ldan pas// lag g.yon sgreng ba g.yas pa yis// lan gsum 'phur zhing g.yas pa la'ang*// phyag rgya de bsgyur lan gsum bshud// thal rdeb gdong dang lus rgyab mdun// lan gsum phur la rkang pa g.yas| |'bebs bcas brkyang ba lag gnyis kyis// lan gsum phur zhing g.yon pa la'ang*// de bzhin byas rjes rdor skyil bca'// lag gnyis khu tshur sta zur du// bzhag la 'bebs gsum mthar ha sprug /gnyis pa nā ro drug skor ni/ lus gnad rlung 'dzin gong ltar las// sked pa g.yas g.yon bskor ba yis// lte ba'i rtsa mdud bshig par byed// gru dpung phyi nang gcus pa yis// snying ga'i rtsa mdud bshig par byed// ske ni gcud skor bsdams pa yis// mgrin pa'i rtsa mdud bshig par byed// mgo bo bskor zhing bcag pa yis// spyi bo'i rtsa mdud bshig par byed// yan lag bzhi yi brkyang bskum gyis// tshigs kyi rtsa rnams dul bar byed// mgo lus med par phur ba yis// lus kyi rtsa rnams grol bar byed// ces so// gsum pa so bdun ma ni/ lus gnad rlung 'dzin sngar ltar la// dbus dang g.yas g.yon sked skor ni// drug gsum bco brgyad mda' 'gengs drug

/zhags skyur dpung rdeg drug drug ste// so drug 'bebs dang so bdun no// zhes pa rnams kyi lag len mthong rgyud ltar ma 'phyugs par nyams su blang ngo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ gtum mo ma zin pa zin par byed pa/ zin pa brtan par byed pa/ brtan pa bogs dbyung ba dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ lus gnad tsog pu la rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthil 'phongs tshos g.yas su gtad/ g.yas de'i phyi nas bsnol ba 'phongs tshos g.yon du gtad/ 'phongs kyi 'og tu gos sogs 'bol ba'i stegs cung zad bzhag /sgom thag bzhi khug la khru gang sor bzhi yod pa'am/ khru gang mdzub gang pa'am/ nyis bltabs kyis mgo la bskor bas 'chang gang lhag pa rnams gang ran rab gnas byas pa rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bor mos pa sked pa dang pus 'og tu bcing*/ lag pa lte 'og tu mnyam bzhag sgom thag gi 'og tu bca'/ gzhan rnams bsam gtan gyi yan lag sngar dang 'dra bas dus ni ha cang 'grangs pa dang*/ ltogs pa dang*/ nyin mtshan gyi gung gnyis dang*/ ngal zhing dub pa'i skabs rnams su mi bsgom la/ dus de rnams ma yin pa'i tshe lus phyi dbyibs rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i khong par rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi sogs gong ltar gsal ba'i lte 'og sor bzhi rtsa gsum 'dus mdor gtum mo a thung bsgom pa la'ang*/ la las thig le'i rnam pa/ la las yi ge a/ la las a shad skyer tsher bcad pa lta bu'i bcad kha steng du bstan pa sogs yod kyang*/ 'dir rang lugs la gtum mo a thung yi ge dbu can gyi lag pa g.yon pa'i dbyibs lta bu sbom pa thur dang rtse mo gyen du phyogs pa dbyibs gru gsum pa dpangs sor gcig tsam/ de'ang rang gi ma las thob pa'i dmar cha'i dwangs ma ste/ kha dog dmar ba/ reg bya tsha ba/ ngo bo bde ba/ rtse mo rno zhing 'khyogs pa ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ yang na ngo bo dmar cha/ rnam pa me/ reg bya tsha ba/ nyams bde ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan/ de'ang shin tu phra ba de'i 'od kyis lus thams cad dro zhing bde bar nus pa/

khyad par lte 'og tu tsha reg mi bzod pa tsam du yod par bsam/ sngar ltar rlung bum pa can bzung ba'i sna bug gi rlung gnyis ro rkyang nas brgyud a shad la phog pas sol me la sbud pa bus pa ltar dmar 'ur 'ur yod pa la sems gtad/ de'ang dmigs rten tsam ma yin pa sems dngos gtum mo la zhugs pa lta bur song ba la ma yeng bar yun ring du rlung sems der bzung la bsgom/ 'di gtum mo nyams len gyi rtsa ba yin pas dmigs pa der ma gtad kyang rlung sems der rtsol med du zin cing drod rnyed pa zhig ma byung bar du 'bad pas sgom pa gal shin tu che'o// gnyis pa zin pa brtan par byed pa ni/ lus gnad gong ltar me thab drug bcings dang ldan pas rlung rngub dgang gzhil gsum byas ma thag ro rkyang gi rlung a shad la phog pas me lce sor bzhi tsam phra sbom mo khab tsam la dbyibs gzugs mo byi thur ltar rtsa rtse phra zhing sked pa sbom par 'bar ba la sems gtad/ slar yang rlung rngub dgang byas pas me lce de nyid las me lce chad pa lug ril tsam dang*/ mthe bong tsam dang*/ bya ma gsar gyi sgo nga tsam pa 'ga' zung chad pas lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su dmar ram me ba la rlung sems 'dzin cing*/ me lce de dag thams cad kyang sa'i rang bzhin rtsub la sra zhing brtan pa/ chu'i rang bzhin snum zhing gsher ba/ me'i rang bzhin tsha zhing sreg pa| rlung gi rang bzhin g.yo zhing 'bar ba ste mtshan nyid bzhi ldan du bsam/ 'di'i skabs su rlung dgang ba'i tshe ro rkyang gi rlung gis ha shad las me lce sbar bar bsam/ gzhil ba'i tshe rlung lhag ma rnams a shad la thim par bsam/ dbyung ba'i tshe a shad kyi rtse mo nas rlung thon pa drod dang bcas dbu ma'i nang du song bar bsam/ dmigs rlung 'di rnams bde drod kyi rmang rdo lta bu yin pas rang lus la bde drod kyi yon tan en tsam ma skyes kyi bar du 'di kho na la 'bad dgos kyi/

'dir yon tan ma skyes par bogs 'don la 'bad kyang myu gu ma skyes par sdong po sogs mi 'byung ba bzhin no// gsum pa bogs 'don la gsum/ drod bogs 'don/ bde ba bogs 'don/ mi rtog pa bogs 'don pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor ro// dang po la'ang gsum/ nang lus la sbar ba/ phyi yul la sbar ba/ phyi nang gnyis med du sbar ba'o// dang po nang lus la sbar ba ni/ lus gnad dang rlung sbyor snga ma ltar la ro rkyang gi rlung gis sbud pas a shad las me cher 'bar bas dbu ma'i nang brgyud lte bar slebs par 'bar bar bsam/ de bzhin du rlung khug re re'am gsum lnga bdun sogs grangs dang bstun nas rim gyis snying ga dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ spyi bo'i bar du me lce 'bar bar bsam/ yang lte ba'i rtsa 'khor mes gang ba'i me lce rgya khab tsam lte ba'i rtsa 'dab rnams kyi nang du song ba so sor gyes pas lus smad kyi ba sbu'i khung bu thams cad kyang mes dmar chil chil gang bar bsam/ de bzhin du snying mgrin spyi bo'i bar sbyar la lus nang thams cad me lces dmar 'ur 'ur gang zhing 'bar bar bsams la rlung sems rtsa ba'i a thung kho na la gtad do// des drod skye bar dka' na lus gnad gzhan snga ma ltar la lag mthil gnyis kyis gru mo gnyis bkab/ gru khug gnyis kyis pus mo gnyis bkab la rlung bzung zhing rlung mi thub pa'i tshe rngub chung gsum re byas la rim pas lte 'og gi g.yas g.yon mdun gsum du gcud cing mnan/ bar rlung rgyun du gzung*/ des kyang drod skye bar dka' na gong ltar lus gnad rlung rtsol dang bcas pa'i ngang nas ro rkyang gi rlung gis a shad la me cher sbar/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi gang*/ de las ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang mes gang*/ lus nang nas phyir 'phros/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas me ri dwags kyi spu lta bus mgo lus thams cad g.yogs pas gos gyon pa lta bur bsam/

yang res 'ga' a shad las me cher 'bar ba shin tu tsha ba'i dud pa dang bcas/ dbu ma nas tshangs bug tu thon pa gdugs ltar kha 'og tu phyogs pa dang*/ me lce thur du phyogs pa 'og sgo nas thon te pad+ma'i 'dab ma ltar kha gyen du phyogs pa gnyis sked pa'i thad du phrad pas rang lus me'i ga'u kha sbyor gyi nang du tshud par bsam mo// gnyis pa phyi yul la sbar ba ni/ lus rlung sngar ltar la lte ba'i a shad las me cher sbar bas lus thams cad la 'bar ba'i me lce bu ga dgu nas thon pas dang po gnas khang*/ de'i rjes yul gru/ mthar 'dzam gling*/ de nas gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad me lce gcig tu 'bar ba bskal pa'i me ltar 'ur chem gyi sgra dang bcas te 'bar bar bsam mo// gsum pa phyi nang gnyis med du sbar ba ni/ lus rlung sngar ltar la a shad las me sbar bas/ lus phyi nang thams cad me'i gos gyon pa ltar gyur/ phyi rol phyogs bzhi nas shin tu tsha ba'i tsha zer dang bcas pa'i nyi ma bzhi shar ba'i 'od zer dang rang lus kyi me lce 'dres pas dbyer med du 'bar zhing rang lus lcags bsregs pa ltar dmar zhing tsha bar gyur par bsam/ de ltar me dmigs thams cad kyi dus rang lus la shin tu tsha ba'i drod 'bar zhing mi bzod pa tsam du gyur par bsam mo// gnyis pa ni| de rnams thun mong du drod kyi 'khrul 'khor bya ba ni gsum/ rgya gar gangs seng ma/ gtsub shing me'i 'khor lo// gangs seng rtsa ba yan lag gi 'khrul 'khor dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mnyam med mi la'i dgongs pa mchog /rgya gar gangs seng 'khrul 'khor ni/ me thab drug bcings bum can las// sked pa g.yas g.yon bskor ba dang*| |gru dpung gcu zhing rgyab mdun du// 'phul 'then 'bebs rnams gsum gsum bya// drod kyi 'khrul 'khor dang po'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten mgon po'i khyad par chos// gtsub shing me yi 'khor lo ni// tsog pu rkang bsnol srin lag gis// rkang mtheb bzung zhing sked skor dang*// dpung pa gzengs dbab rdeg 'tshog kun// gsum gsum bya ba'i lus gnad ni// drod kyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis pa'o// gsum pa ni/

rgyal dbang kun dga'i dgongs pa mchog /gangs seng rtsa ba yan lag gi// 'khrul 'khor gcig tu dril ba ni/ lus gnad me thab drug bcings la// rlung gnad sbyor bzhi bum pa can// sked skor pus gzur dpung 'bebs dang*// 'phul 'then 'bebs rnams gsum gsum bya// drod kyi 'khrul 'khor gsum pa'o// zhes pa ltar gnad ma 'phyugs par bya/ drod kyi gegs rngul chu 'dzag na sran phyes 'phur zhing mi bskyod pas khrus bya/ des kyang ma phan na sngar bshad pa ltar rngul dgram pa'i 'khrul 'khor so bdun ma la 'bad do// de ltar 'bad pas drod skye lugs kyang glo bur du lus thams cad tsha 'ur du byed pa ni/ drod che ba ltar snang yang mi brtan cing gegs mang la/ thog mar lte 'og tsha chil byed/ de'i rjes lte ba nas rim gyis mched de lus thams cad la drod gdung ba med par bde nyams dang bcas 'bar ba ni yon tan skye ba ste drod rnal ma'o// de'ang rlung 'khrul 'khor drag pos btsan thabs su drod skyes pa ni gnas skabs su myur ba ltar snang yang yon tan mi skye zhing dgos pa chung la/ dmigs pa dang 'jam rlung la brten nas drod rim can du dal bus skyes pa ni yon tan brtan cing dgos pa che ba yin no// 'di la'ang drod skye ba'i tshe sha pags mtshams nas drod 'bar ba dang*/ lus nges med du drod skye ba dang*/ tsha 'ur gyis 'bar ba rnams me rlung btsan thabs su 'bar ba'i drod yin pas gyi nar bas la/ dang po a shad kyi thad so nas drod cung zad nang du skyes nas de dag bul ba'i tshul gyis dal bus dmigs rim ltar 'khor lo so so nas mu can du drod 'jam por skyes te/ mthar tsha gdung med pa'i dro 'jam gyis lus khyab pa ni gtum mo'i drod yin pas 'dis byang sems dkar dmar 'phel ba'i grogs byed do// gnyis pa bde ba bogs 'don la gsum/ 'bar 'dzag la dmigs pa/ dga' bzhi la dmigs pa/

zhu bde la dmigs pa'o| |dang po 'bar 'dzag la dmigs pa ni/ lus gnad dang rlung 'dzin gong ltar byas pas spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus tshangs bug gi thad du/ byang sems dkar po'i rang bzhin thig le yungs 'bru tsam zhig dkar 'tsher snum bag dang ldan pa yod pa/ ro rkyang gi rlung gis a shad sbar bas me lce sor bzhi tsam 'bar ba'i drod kyis spyi bo'i thig le zhu nas/ dbyibs zla tshes thig le nā da dang bcas pa'i haṃ yig mgo thur bstan gyi rnam pa/ phra sbom nas 'bru tsam la/ ring thung sor gang tsam snum zhing dkar la 'od 'tsher bar gyur par bsam/ slar ro rkyang gi rlung gis a shad sbud pas me cher 'bar bas g.yon zla ba'i rgyu ba bkag ste ro ma'i nang du yar 'bar/ snying ga'i thad du sleb tshe dbu ma'i nang du 'khyogs te/ snying ga'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su buṃ/ phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhi'i mdun du hūm̐/ g.yon du khaṃ/ rgyab tu dz+riṃ/ g.yas su aṃ rnams rtsa mdud kyi rnam par yod pa bkrol/ slar me lce mar bab nas lte 'og tu sleb tshe g.yas nyi ma'i rgyu ba bkag nas rkyang ma'i nang du 'bar ba mgrin pa'i thad du sleb tshe dbu ma'i nang du 'khyogs te 'bar bas/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su lāṃ/ phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhir bāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ rnams rtsa mdud kyi rnam par gnas pa bkrol/ me de nyid g.yas g.yon nyi zla'i rgyu ba bkag ste dbu ma'i nang du cher 'bar bas 'khor lo 'og ma gsum rim gyis bgrod de/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su 'bar ba'i tshe haṃ las dkar cha 'o ma'i rgyun ltar zags pa me dang 'phrad du nye ba na me lce mgrin par bab/ dkar cha 'dzag pa mgrin par slebs pa na me snying gar bab/ dkar cha snying gar 'dzag pa na me lte bar bab/ dkar cha lte ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su slebs pa na me a shad la thim pa la sems gtad/ slar rlung bzung ba'i tshe ro rkyang nas bus pas a shad las dmar cha'i rang bzhin can gyi me dmar zhing tsha ba 'bar ba lte ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sleb tshe dkar cha yar ldog snying gar slebs/

me snying gar sleb tshe dkar cha mgrin pa/ me mgrin par sleb tshe dkar cha spyi bo'i haṃ la thim zhing me'ang rim gyis smad nas a shad la thim par bsam mo// gnyis pa dga' bzhi la dmigs pa ni/ yang rlung bzung bas ro rkyang gi rlung gis bus pas a shad las me cher 'bar ba lte ba'i 'khor lo brgal tsam du sleb tshe haṃ las dkar cha'i thigs pa zags pa me la phog pas tsheg sgra dang bcas cher 'bar ba spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas/ haṃ las dkar cha'i rgyun bab pa me lce'i shugs kyis bteg pas bde chen 'khor lo'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus dkar mer gyis gang*/ slar dkar cha bab cing me lces bteg pas rtsa 'khor gyi dbus su ma shong bar rtsa 'dab so gnyis su song ba'i rtsa 'dab ba spu'i khung tshun chad ngang mer gyis gang bas bde ba'i nyams rtsol med du skyes pa na dga' ba'i ye shes/ slar bde chen 'khor lo ba spu'i mthar thug par gang nas mar bab pa dang*/ me lce mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor du slebs pa na dkar cha bab pa me lces bteg nas/ gong bzhin mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab ba spu'i khung tshun chad gang ba'i tshe sngar bas nyis 'gyur gyi bde ba'i nyams skyes pa na mchog dga'i ye shes/ slar dkar cha bab me snying gar sleb tshe dkar cha yang snying ga'i 'khor lor slebs pa me lces bteg nas/ snying ga'i rtsa 'khor ba spu'i mthar thug pa gong ltar gang ba'i tshe sngar bas bzhi 'gyur gyis che ba'i bde ba g.yo ba ni dga' bral gyi ye shes/ slar dkar cha cher bab pa na me lce lte ba'i 'khor lor sleb cing dkar cha lte bar slebs pa me lces bteg pas/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor ba spu'i mthar thug pa gang zhing sngar las brgyad 'gyur gyis che ba'i bde ba 'bar ba na lhan skyes kyi ye shes su mnyam par bzhag /slar rlung sbyor snga ma ltar byas pas a shad las dmar cha'i rang bzhin me'i rnam pa cher 'bar ba dkar chas mnan pa ltar byas pa'i tshe/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor ba spu'i khung gi mthar thug par gang bar lug ldog gi dga' ba'i ye shes/

yang dmar cha 'bar ba snying gar slebs pa dkar chas mnan pa na/ snying gar rtsa 'khor ba spu'i mthar thug par gang bas mchog dga'/ yang gong bzhin me mgrin par slebs pa dkar chas mnan pas mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor ba spu'i mthar thug pa gang ba dga' bral/ yang gong ltar 'bar ba me lce spyi bor sleb cing dkar chas mnan pas spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor ba spu'i mthar thug par gang ba lhan skyes/ mthar dkar cha haṃ la thim zhing me lce a shad la bstim mo// 'dir dga' bzhi'i rtogs pa'ang dang por gtum mo'i mes byang sems bzhu nas dbu mar bab pa 'khor lo so sor rlung sems thig le gsum 'jug pa gcig tu bsgoms pas rim gyis bde ba skyes pa la/ dga' ba la sogs pa blos btags nas de la lta bas rgyas btab pa lta bu'i dga' bzhi rjes mthun pa tsam las mi 'byung la/ de nyid 'bad pas bsgoms pas rlung dbu mar tshud cing byang sems zhu ba rim gyis gnas rnams su bab pas dga' ba bzhi ji lta ba 'char zhing ye shes rjes mthun pa tsam las mi skye| slar 'bad pas rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byas te byang sems bab pa 'khor lo bzhir brtan pas dga' bzhi'i bde ba 'char ba dang*/ sems kyi ngo bo stong nyid dbyer med du shar ba ngos zin pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes ji lta ba yin no// gsum pa zhu bde la dmigs pa ni/ lus rlung gong ltar la a shad la me 'bar bas haṃ las dkar cha bab pa me dang 'dres pa dkar dmar khrag dang 'o ma 'dres pa lta bu rim gyis spyi mgrin snying lter bab cing*/ rtsa 'khor de dag ba spu'i mthar thug pa gang zhing mthar spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar thams cad dkar dmar 'dres pas khrigs mer gyis gang bar bsam mo// de rnams la 'bad kyang bde ba'i nyams cher ma skyes na/ lus rlung gong ltar la a shad las me 'bar bas haṃ las dkar cha'i thigs pa thig le hūm̐ dkar po'i rnam par bab pa dbu ma nas brgyud rdo rje nor bu'i rtsa bar bab pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad cing rlung bzung la/

rdo rje nor bu 'phul 'then dang 'byed 'dzum mang du byas pa'i tshe thig le'i hūm̐ yig rdo rje'i bu gar brgyud nas rtse mor ngang ye re 'dug par bsams pa la sems gtad pas bde ba'i nyams ches che bar skye ba ni gtum mo rtag pa'i phyag rgya/ bde ba'i ngo bo stong nyid dang ro gcig pa ni chos kyi phyag rgya/ bde stong gnyis med kyi ngang nas byang sems 'pho med du nyams su blang ba dam tshig gi phyag rgya zhes skabs 'dir mtshon pa tsam du bzhed la/ tshul de dag gis bde ba skye dka' na mdun du ye shes kyi phyag rgya gsal btab yid kyis snyoms 'jug bya ba dang*/ des kyang bde ba skye dka' na dman pa las kyi phyag rgya rang lus dang gzhan lus gnyis kyi sgo nas nyams su blang ba ni ches zab la myur ba ste/ bla ma mnyes par byas pa'i gsung gi gsang ba las rtogs par byos shig /de ltar nyams su blangs pas bde ba 'bar zhing byang sems 'phor nye na gang zag sbyangs pa can la 'dun pa tsam gyis 'dzin ldog nus mod kyang*/ las dang po pa la de ltar mi 'byung bas rlung dmigs 'khrul 'khor gsum gyi sgo nas byang sems mi nyams shing 'phel rgyas las rung du bya ba'i phyir/ dang po byang sems ma bzung na bde ba'i shugs kyis 'chor srid pas 'dzin pa'i 'khrul 'khor gcig /bzung nas cung zad gyen du ma ldog na 'dren par dka' bas ldog pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi/ ldog nas yar ma drangs na gnas der nad du 'gyur bas 'dren gyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis/ drangs nas gnas su ma bskyal na thig le las su mi rung zhing phyis nyams pa'i gegs byed pas gnas su skyel ba'i 'khrul 'khor gcig /gnas su bskyal nas lus thams cad la ma khrems na byang sems 'phel rgyas mi 'byung bas 'grems pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis/ khrems kyang rlung dang ma bsres na bde drod bskyed mi nus pas rlung dang bsre ba'i 'khrul 'khor gcig

/rlung dang bsres nas rtsa mig thams cad du ma btab na bde drod khol bu tsam las lus kun khyab par dka' zhing*/ khyad par rtsa rlung thig le gsum ga las su rung ba'i yon tan bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes mi skye bas rtsa mig tu gdab pa'i 'khrul 'khor gcig ste/ de ltar na spyir btang du byang sems 'dzin ldog 'dren skyel 'grems sre gdab pa ste 'khrul 'khor sde tshan bdun la/ bye brag nang gses su dbye na bcu gnyis yod pas na/ brgyud pa gzhan gyi man ngag las ches rmad du byung ba rgyal dbang skyob pa yab sras kyi phyag bzhes lus sbyong bcu gnyis mar grags pa thig le'i 'khrul 'khor shin tu zab pa mthar thug pa ni 'di lta ste/ dang po thig le 'dzin pa sbyor ba drug ldan ri rab 'degs pa rdo rje 'chang gi phyag rgya ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung la// rgal tshigs rab tu bsrang bya zhing*// rdo rje'i khu tshur snying gar bsnol// nyi zla'i sgo gnyis gyen ldog bsgril// rlung gnad pho rlung sgang dril gyi// dmigs pa gser gyi mchod rten nam// ri rab bteg cing mkha' ru yal// 'degs tshul snying ga nas gyen du// smin mtshams bar du dal bu yis// lan gsum bya ba gnad yin no// gnyis pa ldog pa'i 'khrul 'khor bzhi'i dang po kā hig yi dwags kyi 'dug stangs ni/ rkang pa rdor skyil lag pa g.yas// rdo rje'i khu tshur mchan 'og brten// lag g.yon sdigs mdzub nam mkhar sgreng*// rlung ni phyir dbyung kā hig sgra// rlung mig sems gsum mdzub rtser gtad// phyag rgya de bsgyur lan gsum bya// gnyis pa hring hring dri za'i 'dug stangs ni/ drang por langs pa'i rkang lag ni// gcu zhing brgyangs la hring gi sgras// rlung phyir dbyung zhing g.yon nas g.yas// gcu zhing g.yon du'ang de ltar bya| |de nyid gsum gsum bya ba'o// gsum pa khri 'degs gyad kyi 'dug stangs ni/

rkang gnyis 'phred du lo ma dag /sar phab rting pas 'phongs bteg la// lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur yang*| |dpung thad so sor bcangs byas te// srog rtsol thur sel lte 'og sbyar// nywa bzhi'i sha dang shed bsgrims la// 'degs tshul lan gsum bya ba'o// bzhi pa bgrad pa'i thad bzhi ni| |langs pa'i rkang lag thad bzhir bgrad// srog thur lte 'og kha sbyar la// chun bcas cung zad g.yas g.yon dgyer// gsum pa 'dren gyi 'khrul 'khor gnyis kyi dang po glang chen hing ring ni/ pus btsugs lag gnyis khu tshur ni// mdun du kha sbubs hing gi sgras// rlung ni phyir dbyung ltag pa dgye// gnyis pa stag mo'i skyug stangs ni// pus btsugs lag ngar sar phab cing*// khu tshur dgye ba hag gi sgras// mgo bo gyen phyogs rlung phyir dbyung*// bzhi pa gnas su skyel ba wa mo'i snom tshul ni/ rdor skyil khu tshur pus steng bzhag /kha g.yon phyogs pas rngub chung ni// g.yas su 'bud cing g.yas pa nas// rngub chung g.yon du 'bud pa dag /gsum gsum dbus nas rngub pa yang*// dbus su 'bud pa lan gsum bya'o// lnga pa 'grems pa'i 'khrul 'khor gnyis kyi dang po g.yang mo'i sgang sprug ni/ pus btsugs lus sgur khu tshur ni// sar phab rlung gnad bum can gyi// g.yas g.yon gsum gsum gcus pa'i mthar// lus gnad de las sprug pa'o// gnyis pa nya mo'i 'phar rdeb ni// bum can rlung bzung gan rkyal nyal// rkang lag mkha' ru brkyang rdeb gsum// de ltar lus kyang lan gsum brdab// drug pa rlung dang bsre ba bag bzhi 'phra ba ni/ rlung gnad bum can kha sbyor la// sgreng ba'i rkang lag g.yas pa ni// nang du bskor zhing 'phra ba dang*// phyi ru bskor zhing 'phra ba dag /gsum gsum g.yon la'ang de bzhin bya'o// bdun pa rtsa mig tu gdab pa sgo dgu dgag pa seng ge rnam rol ni/ rdor skyil lus bsrang rlung phyir 'dzin// mtha' ltag gis kha gung mos sna// mdzub mos mig dang mthe bong gis// rna ba bkag la g.yas g.yon du// sgur zhing dgyer ba gsum gsum bya'o// zhes so// de rnams kyi dmigs pa ni/

'dzin pa'i dus byang sems rdo rje nor bu'i nang du slebs pa 'phor nye ba'i tshe 'khrul 'khor dang pos gnas de nyid du ngang phung gis 'pho med bzung bar bsam/ ldog pa'i tshe rdo rje'i sbubs nas lte 'og tu skya chil gyis ldog par bsam/ 'dren pa'i tshe khron chu dpyangs thag gis drangs pa ltar dbu ma'i nang du skya nar nar gyen du drang bar bsam/ gnas su skyel ba'i tshe 'khor lo so sor zho chags pa ltar gnas par bsam/ 'grems pa'i tshe zhing la chu bkye ba ltar rtsa 'dab rnams su chil chil bkye/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi po ngang mer mer gang bar bsam/ rlung dang sre ba'i tshe rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi byang sems kyis gang ba de nyid srog rtsol gyi rlung dang bsres pas mi shong zhing rgya mtsho rlabs kyis skyod pa ltar ram g.yo zhing 'bar bar bsam/ rtsa mig tu gdab pa'i tshe byang sems g.yo zhing 'bar ba rlung dang 'dres pa de nyid rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi brgyud spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar lus phyi nang ba spu'i khung gi mthar thug pa thams cad du gyes shing sim pas/ dug hrul la snum zhen pa ltar khyab cing zhen nas lus thams cad la tshad med pa'i bde drod skyes par bsam mo// skabs 'dir khrid yig rnying pa rnams su kun+da bsrung dka' na sum chos ltar gnad du bsnun par gsungs pa ni/ dang po nyon mongs pa lam du gtong ba'i man ngag ni/ bde nyams 'dod chags kyi rtog pa de ngos tsir gyis bzung la khab mig tu skud pa 'dzud pa'am gzhu bdung ba'i tshad tsam du ma yeng bar byas la sher snying bklag pa'i yun tsam du lam du gtang zhing gnad la dbab/ gnyis pa bde chen byang chub sems kyi man ngag ni/ snga ma'i mu de nyid las byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas thig le g.yos pa rnams 'dzag med du 'gyur zhing dug la sngags btab pas sman du 'gyur pa ltar nyon mongs pa bde bar gyur pas gnas skabs su sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i zhal mthong bar 'gyur/

gsum pa theg chen gsang sngags kyi man ngag ni/ de ma thag lus yi dam du gsal btab pas byang sems ba spu'i mthar thug par khrems shing yon tan mtha' yas pa rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro// sum chos kyi man ngag 'di ni rang ga'i nyon mongs kyi rtog pa skyes dus mdo sngags zung 'jug gi nyams len tshad med par snang yang*/ gtum mo sogs sngags kyi nyams len rang gi tshe lam gtong dang byang sems kyi rgyas 'debs sogs lam thun mong bar 'dug pas de bas bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes gcer yan du skyong ba nyid legs la/ byang sems 'pho ba'i gegs sel tsam du ni 'di yang mi 'gyur ba ma yin no// yang byang sems 'pho bar nye ba na 'dren rkyang pa la 'bad pas rkang pa 'khums pa sogs kyi skyon byung na gtum mo sku bsring ba'i man ngag ni/ lus gnad dang rlung gnad snga ma ltar la rang lus lha sku'i nang du rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi haṃ yig a shad rnams sngar ltar gsal btab la/ de'i sku smad rtsa 'khor a shad dang bcas pa mda' rgyang gsum tsam mam dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa tsam du mar bsrings/ sku sked yan chan mi bsring bar rang sor bsgom/ de nas a shad la sems yun ring du gtad nas a shad las me sor gcig nas gnyis gsum bzhi'i bar rim gyis sbar/ bde ba'i shugs che na me gyen la bsrings pas byang sems sdong bu'i me lces zhun mar drangs pa ltar/ 'drong bar 'gyur ro// sku bsring ba 'di ha cang yun ring du mi bsgom mo// skabs 'dir gtum mo bde drod kyi lang tsho ngom pa'i phyir du ras 'bud bgyi ba ni gsum/ rab lta ba gnyis med kyi ye shes rtogs pa don dam mchog gi gtum mo mngon du gyur pas/ kun rdzob dmigs rlung 'khrul 'khor gang la'ang ltos mi dgos par bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes su dus 'da' ba'i phyir/ sgyu ma lta bu'i lus la tsha grang gi reg bya thams cad ngo bo stong zhing chos skur shar ba dag go// 'bring mchog gi gtum mo mngon du ma gyur kyang shes yul rang mdangs dri ma dang bral zhing*/

gang dmigs der snang gi yul las skad cig kyang mi 'da' bas ni drod dmigs tsam gyis rang lus dros pa lta zhog /lung pa de nyid kyi chab rom rnams kyang zhu ba sogs 'byung ngo*// tha ma dmigs rlung 'khrul 'khor la goms pas ni dgun 'khyag sgang gi dus slob ma rnams mtshan sogs sro lo dmar po/ khrus bya/ mal stan gru gsum du ras rkyang sgom thag dang bcas pas gnas pa la bla mas bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom zhing rab gnas bya/ dmigs pa dngos ni mal stan me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbus su rang lus seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis gnas pa'i lag pa g.yas g.yon nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shin tu tsha ba 'od 'bar ba gnyis kyi dbus su rang lus kyang lcags gong bsregs pa lta bur bsam zhing*/ phyi snod nang bcud kyi me rnams kyang bsdus nas lte 'og sor bzhir me bya sgong tsam la sems mnyam par bzhag /snam sbyar ram/ dar ram/ ras kyi bgo ba dang ldan pas bde bar nyal/ cung zad grang na drod kyi 'khrul 'khor gsum dang rlung bum can la'ang 'bad do// yang mgon po 'bri gung pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag ni lte 'og sor bzhi rtsa gsum 'dus mdor bde drod gnyis ka'i rang bzhin can gyi thig le dkar zhing dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa snum zhing 'dril ba bya sgong tsam du bsam/ de la sems brten nas de las gnyis dang bzhi brgyad dang bcu drug du gyes par bsam/ de la goms nas lus nang thams cad thig le dkar dmar gyis gang bar bsam/ mthar thig le de thams cad rtsa ba'i thig le la bsdu'o// de ltar gtum mo sku bsring ba dang thig le'i dmigs pa 'di dag gi tshe bde ba cher skyes na 'dren 'grems kyi 'khrul 'khor bsdus pa ras chung drug skor du grags pa ni/ dang po mgur chu bum pa mnye// rdor skyil bum can lag gnyis ni// brkyang 'phur mgrin pa mnye ba'o// gnyis pa ri bo rtse nas bsgul// skyil krung pus steng khu tshur brgyangs// bum can mgo bo g.yas g.yon bskor// gsum pa rgya mtsho gting nas dkrug

/lus rlung de las rgya mtsho ni// skyom rdeb g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bskor// bzhi pa gling bzhi dbang du sdud// bum can gan rkyal yan lag bzhi| |brkyang zhing lus la brdab pa gsum// lnga pa bya rkang rdo rje 'gros// bum can rdor skyil sgyid khug tu// lag ngar g.yas g.yon bcug byas pa// khu tshur bcangs pa'i mthe bong la| |ljid bkal ba la 'bebs gsum bya// drug pa seng ge rnam rol ni// lus sbyong bcu gnyis skabs ltar ro// zhes so// gsum pa mi rtog pa bogs dbyung ba la'ang gsum/ lta ba spros bral du thag bcad pa/ gnas lugs thun mong ba zhi lhag gi gzhi bzung ba/ thun mong ma yin pa bde stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin skyong tshul lo// dang po lta ba spros bral du thag bcad pa ni/ mgon po byams pas/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas// de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs// blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas// de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas// zhes dang*/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mtha' ster zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar phu thag chod par bya ba yin no// gnyis pa gnas lugs thun mong ba zhi lhag gi gzhi bzung ba ni/ mgon po byams pas/ yid la byed pa brjod med par// ro gcig pas kyang spyad par bya// chos kyi ming ni bsdoms pa 'di// zhi gnas lam du shes par bya// lhag mthong lam ni de don rnams// rnam par spyod par shes par bya// zung du 'brel ba'i lam de ni// sdom pa yin par shes par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir las dang po pa sngon chad sems dngos po'i gnas lugs stong pa nyid la 'dris goms med pa'i gsar bu pa yin na zhi lhag gi lam gyis stong nyid la goms 'dris bya dgos pas lnga ldan gyi sa bcad rtsa tshig rdo rje'i tshig rkang ltar skabs 'dir sems nyid ngo 'phrod par bya'o| |gsum pa thun mong ma yin pa bde stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin skyong tshul la'ang gnyis/

zhu bde dpe'i lhan skyes dang*/ don dam mchog gi gtum mo gnyis so// dang po zhu bde dpe'i lhan skyes ni/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rnal 'byor gyis rlung dbu mar bcug pas gtum mo 'bar te byang sems zhu ba'i tshe dga' ba bzhi rim gyis ngos bzung ba'i tha mar byang sems nor bu'i sbubs su 'ongs shing*/ phyir ma 'phos pa'i bar der nyams su myong ba'i ye shes de ni dpe'i lhan skyes yin la/ de nyid bsgom pa la bsgom bya ngos zin dgos pas de ngos 'dzin pa ni| de'ang byang sems bab nas ma 'phos pa'i bar der bde nyams skyes pas rnam rtog 'gags nas sems mi rtog par gnas pa tsam la bde stong gi ye shes ngos mi 'dzin te/ zhal lung las| |chos sku rab dga' mkha' mnyam pa// shi dang brgyal dang gnyid log dang*// glal dang 'khrig dus skad cig tsam// myong bar 'gyur ba rab bsgom na// zhes shi ba'i tshe dang*/ dran med du brgyal ba'i tshe dang*/ gnyid log pa'i tshe dang*/ glal ba dang*/ dbang po gnyis sbyor ba'i dus te/ lnga po der yang phar phyin theg pa'i 'od gsal stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu nges par 'byung mod/ de'i tshe yang rnam rtog 'gags nas sems gsal stong du gnas pa las 'os med kyang*/ des skabs 'di'i bde stong zung 'jug dpe'i lhan skyes su mi 'gyur ro// 'o na shi ba dang*/ gnyid 'thug dang*/ dbang po gnyis sbyor gsum gyi 'od gsal de ni sngags lam gyi nyams len min nam zhe na bden mod kyang*/ sngags lam gyi skabs de dag thabs su byas pa yin gyi thabs tshul de las skyes pa'i rnam rtog 'gags pa'i stong nyid tsam dpe'i lhan skyes min la/ de'i tshe rnam rtog skad cig la 'gags pa ma yin pa dga' ba bzhi/ stong pa bzhi/ snang mched thob gsum rim gyis ngos bzung zhing nyams su myong ba'i tshe rim gyis rtog pa 'gags shing bde ba skyes pa/ bde ba'i ngo bo stong pa'i rang bzhin can|

de'ang bde ba 'di'o// stong pa 'di'o// zhes so sor dbyer med pa/ dper na ga pur dang de'i dri ltar lhan skyes la/ de'ang ga pur mthong na de'i dri yang tshor la/ de'i dri tshor na de nyid yod pa bzhin du bde ba 'bar tsam nyid nas stong pa'i ye shes rang chas su yod pa/ stong nyid shar tsam nyid nas bde ba rang chas su yod pa/ de'ang gsal la mi rtog pa 'dzin zhen dang bral ba/ rnam rtog gi bsam gzugs thams cad gdod nas dag cing bde stong sgyu mar shar ba don dam pa'i lhan skyes dang cha 'dra ba/ de'ang gzhan du ma btsal bar rang rgyud la nyams su myong bas bde stong gi ngang du ting nge 'dzin gsal 'tsher shugs drag dang bcas pas lus sems gnyis med du khyab pa la de'i don 'di 'dra'o// zhes ngag tu smrar mi btub pa de nyid zhu bde dpe'i lhan skyes yin la/ 'di ni dbang gsum pa'i ye shes nyid yin pa'i phyir mnga' bdag mai tri pas dpe'i ye shes dang*/ rje nā ro pas don gyi ye shes su bzhed la/ rje mar pas de gnyis dgongs pa mthun par bkral ba ni/ 'dod chags bde chen du ma bcing ba la dpe'i ye shes dang*/ 'dod chags bde chen du bcings pa la don gyi ye shes yin zhes gsungs la/ de'i dgongs pa'ang gang zag dbang po rab de kho na nyid mngon sum du rtogs pas zhu bde'i lhan skyes 'di nyams su myong ma thag dper na chu nang gi zla ba mthong bas na nam mkha'i zla ba ngo shes pa ltar zhu bde dpe'i ye shes 'di mthong ma thag don gyi ye shes rtogs par 'gyur ba la dgongs shing*/ gang zag dbang po tha ma de kho na nyid yin tshul tsam rtogs pas ni zhu bdes drangs pa'i ye shes de nyid dper byas nas des 'khor 'das thams cad la rgyas btab nas bsgoms pas zhu bde la ltos mi dgos par don gyi ye shes nyams su myong ba la dgongs pa yin no// des na bshad ma thag pa'i gtum mo la sogs pa'i phyag rgya gang rung la brten nas zhu bde dpe'i ye shes la rtsal sbyangs shing nyams su blangs pas tshul de nyid las byung ba'i bde stong la nges pa rnyed par bya dgos pas/

de'i phyir dga' ba tha ma byang sems phyir ma 'phos pa'i skabs kyi bde stong de'ang blos byas bcos sgom ma yin par/ blo 'das bcos min gyi bde stong gnyis med dpe'i lhan skyes 'di nyid yun bsrings nas sgom zhing 'bad pas bskyang bar bya dgos so// gnyis pa don dam mchog gi gtum mo don gyi ye shes ni/ de ltar dpe'i lhan skyes la goms shing 'dris pas/ don gyi ye shes ni yan lag bdun dang ldan pa ste/ de'ang phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid las 'das shing pra phab pa lta bu stong nyid gzugs brnyan du'ang snang ba shes bya thams cad la khyab pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa/ dmigs bcas kyi stong nyid rnam kun mchog ldan dang dmigs med kyi snying rje mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po dbyer mi phyed pas na kha sbyor/ tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba dang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog dbyings su dag pas bde chen/ gshis kyi gnas lugs spros pa thams cad dang bral ba bden par grub pa spu tsam yang med pas rang bzhin med pa/ dga' bzhi sogs phra rags kyi spros pa med par lhan skyes kho na las 'pho 'gyur gang du'ang med pa snying rjes yongs su gang ba de rnams kyang rgyun gyi rtag pa ste/ de'ang dngos med kyi rtag pa rgyun chad can min par byang chub kyi bar du rgyun chad 'gro 'ong bri gang med pas rgyun mi 'chad pa/ de'ang med dgag ci med cang med kyi stong pa ma yin par don dam pa bde ba chen po'i gzugs can yin pas 'gag pa med pa zhes bya ste/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ longs spyod rdzogs dang kha sbyor bde chen rang bzhin med// snying rjes yongs gang rgyun mi 'chad dang 'gog pa med// yan lag bdun dang ldan pas sangs rgyas 'di nyid ni// bdag 'dod tshad mas yod dgos blo can rnams kyang 'dod// ces gsungs so// des na mchog gi gtum mo ni yan lag bdun dang ldan pa nyid yin te/

dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ mchog tu mi 'gyur sbyor ba yi// phyag rgya chen mo rnam par bsgom// zhes so// de'ang ji lta bu zhe na/ rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i mtshan nyid brgyad dang ldan pa ste/ zab gsal gnyis su med pa/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa las grol ba/ spros pa dang bral ba/ bsam brjod las 'das pa/ nam mkha' ji srid bar mi zad pa/ rtag cing brtan pa/ zag pa med pa/ rgya che ba ste mtshan nyid brgyad dang ldan pa/ mdor na rnal 'byor pa gcig gi rgyud kyi bde ba de'i cha tsam la'ang 'jig rten na yod do cog gi bde ba gcig tu bsdoms pas kyang de'i char yang mi phod pa yin no// yang na de dag khyad par bdun dang ldan pas kyang 'jig rten las 'das pa nyid yin te/ bdun ni/ mchog gi bde ba chen po rgyas pa dang*/ sim pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa med pa dang*/ bar chad med pa dang*/ khyab pa dang*/ 'gag pa med pa dang*/ 'khor ba ji srid bar rgyun mi 'chad pa ste khyad par bdun dang ldan pa'o// de ltar na de nyid sgom pa'i tshe'ang bdag nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lhar bsgyur ba 'od du zhu ba srung 'khor la thim/ srung 'khor 'od du zhu ba rang lus la thim/ rang lus kyang rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi la thim/ de'ang ro rkyang dbu ma la thim/ 'khor lo bzhi haṃ yig dbu ma dang bcas pa a shad la thim/ a shad kyang skra'i rtse mo brgyar bshags pa'i cha tsam je phrar gyur nas mthar mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas spros bcas kyi rtog dpyod dran 'dzin gnyen po had sgom ngar rlom thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang nas sngar gyi zhu bdes drangs pa'i zung 'jug gi ye shes de nyid kyi rgyun bskyangs nas 'bad pas bsgom/ rang rgyud la bde stong gi nyams rtsol med du skyes pa la yul yul can gnyis snang gi rtog pa phra mo'ang yod pa ni dpe'i ye shes dngos yin la/ mthar de nyid gong 'phel du gyur nas yul yul can gnyis snang gi rtog pa shin tu phra ba'ang dag nas snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad bde stong gnyis med zung 'jug gi ye shes 'ba' zhig tu shar ba ni don gyi ye shes zhes skabs 'dir bzhed pa yin no// gsum pa rjes la'ang gsum/

gtum mo'i dam tshig bshad pa/ lam gyi gegs dang 'phrang bshad pa/ rtags dang yon tan 'char tshul bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ drod kyi dam tshig tu grang yang lci can dang bem po mi gyon/ dro yang gcer bu mi bya bar gos srab mo 'ga' re gyon la drod skyes rim gyis gos cung zad srab tu btang*/ me dang nyi ma la ha cang mi sro/ dung mi 'bud/ chu mi brgal/ rkang rjen mi bya/ 'khyags pa'i snang ba yid la mi bya/ rlung thun dang lus sbyong ma chag par bya/ me la phu mi btab/ zas skom grang mo spang ngo// bde ba'i dam tshig tu dgos pa gal chen ma gtogs byang sems ma nyams par bsrung*/ sga g.yer/ zwa tshod/ ri sgog /sha rul/ nya sha/ chang tsha skyur can/ lan tshwa ches pa'i zas skom rnams spang*/ stan med dang sa rlon la yun ring mi sdod/ nyin gnyid dang rngul thon pa'i bya ba spang*| bar rlung yun du bsten cing kha'i rlung bsdams shing kha zas drod bcud can lhag par bsten/ dka' thub la sogs lus dang rtsa dang stobs nyams pa'i sran thub mi bya/ mi rtog pa'i dam tshig tu dben pa bsten cing snang shes spang*/ rnam rtog la dgag sgrub mi bya zhing 'dod chags lam du slong ba sogs bya'o// bde drod mi rtog pa sogs gtum mo spyi'i dam tshig tu dbang gsum pa dang bzhi pa'i dam tshig rnams dang*/ rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi pa shes rab la smod pa spong ba sogs bya ba gal che'o// gnyis pa gegs dang 'phrang bshad pa ni/ gtum mo la dus gsum zhes pa gtum mo sdug bsngal gyi dus ni/ lus dang rtsa ma byang bas nad ro ldang zhing na zug 'byung*/ rlung ma byang bas thang chad cing rlung gi nad 'byung*/ thig le ma byang bas lus stobs shor ba dang khams 'dus sogs 'byung*/ dmigs pa ma byang bas 'tshub cing gtan la mi phebs pa sogs na tsha dang sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'byung bas/ de'i tshe thabs mkhas kyis 'drid cing sgom dang sna 'gras ma byung bar rim gyis 'bad cing gzhan pa'i thabs mi bya bar gtum mo nyid la 'bad do// gtum mo 'dod chags kyi dus ni/

rtsa rlung thig le cung zad byang bas bde ba g.yos te khams rgyas pas 'dod chags skye bas de'i tshe rlung dang 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa lus sbyong bcu gnyis ma ltar gnad du bsnun cing 'dir 'ga' zhig gis chags yul la mi sdug pa sgom pa sogs bshad kyang 'dod chags nyid mi spong bar lam du byed pa sngags lam gyi khyad chos yin pas brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su blang zhing sum chos kyis kyang gnad du bsnun to// ma nyams par bya'o// gtum mo yon tan gyi dus ni/ rtsa rlung thig le gsum cung zad las su rung bas bde drod mi rtog pa'i yon tan cung zad skyes pa'i tshe gzhan la bshad pas dam tshig nyams na yon tan ye mi skye bas gsang thub cing nyams len la 'bad/ gzhan yang gtum mo'i drod bzhi zhes pa yi mug sgyid lug brtson 'grus kyi dred ces pa gtum mo'i rlung rtsol dang 'khrul 'khor la ma goms pas yid chad cing sgyid lug tshe/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' zhing rnyed pa don che la/ de'ang myur du 'jig pa'i tshul bsam zhing 'bad pa cher bya/ na tsha dang sdug bsngal byung tshe ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la bltas na nga'i 'di za zi phra'u yin/ nga'i las ngan tshe 'dir smin pa yin snyam dpa' gdeng bskyed/ bzod pa'i go gyon/ bla ma gong ma'i rnam thar la lta zhing brtson pa bskyed/ bza' med dka' thub nyams len gyi dred ces pa longs spyod med pa'am dka' thub la 'bad pas lus stobs zhan na rtsa rlung thig le'i yon tan mi skye bas zas bcud can dang khams 'phel stobs bskyed/ ro btsa'i sbyor ba la 'bad/ mthong snang bar chad bdud kyi dred ces bya ba rtsa rlung thig le gnas so sor cung zad 'dus pas rmi lam nyams snang mngon sum gang rung du dag pa'i zhing dang*/ sangs rgyas/ byang sems/ yi dam/ mkha' 'gro la sogs pa mthong ba dang*/ lung ston pa'i rnam pa 'byung bas de rnams kyang brtags shing dpyad nas don gnyis 'grub pa'i lung bstan tshad mar 'dug na ma gtogs de la sogs pa'i dbang du mi gtang zhing nyams len la 'bad do// rtags snang chos brgyad lo 'dod kyi dred ces bya ba 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung gnas so sor 'dus pas mngon shes dang byin rlabs rdzu 'phrul phra mo ston pa sogs dang*/

gzhan yang yon tan 'ga' yar tsam skyes pas nyams len bskyur te 'gro don byed pa sogs kyis rang gzhan gnyis phung gi las 'ong ba shin tu mang bas de ltar mi byed par yon tan thams cad gsang zhing sba ba'i ngang nas nyams len sor 'dzud/ ras gos sgom thag aṅga rag sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang dgos dus longs spyod pa ma gtogs mi'i sngun du mchor chas mi bya ba sogs lo 'dod chos brgyad spang ba shin tu gal che'o// gzhan yang gegs kyi gtso bo 'byams gsum zhes bya ba/ drod phal par 'byams pa ni/ lus kun khyab pa'i drod tsam la brten nas gos kyi 'khri ba gcod nus pa byung tshe gtum mo'i yon tan skyes par rlom pa dang*/ bde ba rang ga mar 'byams pa ni/ lus khams rgyas pas bde ba skyes tshe bde ba tsam la chags shing zhen nas yon tan du rlom pa dang*/ mi rtog pa stong pa nyid du 'byams pa ni| rang rgyud la stong nyid cir yang ma grub pa'i nyams tsam skyes pas mi rtog pa'i yon tan du rlom nas stong lta had pos rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa 'byung nyen shin tu che bas gzab par bya zhing*| gzhan yang rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs sel rnams ni mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i zab chos rnams nas 'byung ba ltar nyams su blang ngo// gsum pa rtags dang yon tan 'char tshul ni/ thun mong gi drod kyi rtags ni/ lus phyi nang thams cad du drod kyis khyab cing*/ de'ang dbyar drod che la dgun chung ba sogs 'byung ba'i gshis dang me nyi'i rkyen dang zas skom gyi rgyu sogs gang la'ang ma ltos par drod 'jam zhing gdung ba med pa la brtan pas lus khyab cing rtag pa rgyun chad med par 'byung*/ bde ba'i rtags ni/ dngos yid kyi chags lam la ma ltos par nyin mtshan thams cad du bde ba 'bar zhing lus kyi na tsha dang zug rngu thams cad kyang bde bar 'char ba sogs 'byung*/ mi rtog pa'i rtags ni/ sngar bshad pa ltar don gyi lhan skyes skabs 'dir mngon du 'gyur dka' na'ang dpe'i lhan skyes 'bad med du rgyud la skye ba yin/

lam gyi rtags ni/ sa rlung dbang du 'dus pas zhing khams thams cad ser por mthong zhing ri brag sa rdo la thal byung du 'gro ba sogs 'byung*/ de bzhin du me rlung gis dmar por mthong ba dang mes mi 'tshig pa sogs dang*/ chu rlung gis dkar por mthong zhing chu la mi 'bying ba dang*/ rlung gi rlung gis ljang gur mthong zhing phyi nang gi rlung la rang dbang thob pa dang*/ nam mkha'i rlung gis sngon por mthong zhing nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ khams dkar dmar dbu mar brtan pas nyi zla brtod la gnon pa dang*/ sa rdo gser du bsgyur ba dang*/ drod kyis gangs ri 'ju ba dang*/ stong gsum skad cig gis skor nus pa sogs 'byung*| lam gyi rtags gtso bo ni/ du ba/ smig rgyu/ me khyer/ mar me/ nam mkha' lta bu ste mtshan rtags lnga dang*/ nyi zla/ glog /'ja' tshon/ thig le ste nyin rtags lnga dang rtags bcu 'char/ lus sra zhing brtan pa/ snum bag chags pa/ bkrag mdangs rgyas pa/ yang zhing mgyogs pa/ lus yod du mi tshor ba/ grib ma med pa/ gzhan gyis mi mthong ba/ rdzu 'phrul ston nus pa ste yon tan brgyad skye/ gzhan yang grub pa brgyad dang phrin las bzhi la sogs pa thogs med du 'grub cing*/ rtsas nor/ rlung gis mi/ thig les mi ma yin dbang du 'du ba sogs gnas skabs kyi yon tan dpag tu med pa rgyud la skye zhing*/ mthar thug ni sems ye shes rnam kun mchog ldan phyag rgya chen pos gzung 'dzin kun rtog 'khrul ba rtsad nas bcad| ngag brjod bral nā da'i sgra dbyangs gzhom du med pas tha mal ngag rlung gi dri ma thams cad rang sar dwangs/ sku zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bus rtsa thig zag bcas snyigs ma mtshan 'dzin gyi bud shing rtsad nas bsregs te sa bcu gsum pa'i mthar phyin te kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po mngon du byed pa yin no/// / ༈ */spyi don gnyis pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo la brten nas sems rang bzhin gyis rmongs pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma sbyong zhing gti mug lam du byed pa 'od gsal lam gyi snying po la'ang*/

'od gsal ngos gzung ba dang*/ de nyid nyams su blang ba gnyis/ dang po la gnyis/ spyi don gyi 'od gsal dang*/ sbas don gyi 'od gsal lo// dang po spyi don gyi gzhi'i 'od gsal ni sems kyi rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ lam gyi 'od gsal ni zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi nyams len gyi gnad kyis sems gsal stong 'dzin med du rtogs pa/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal ni zab zhi spros bral gyi ye shes so// gnyis pa sbas don gyi 'od gsal la'ang gzhi'i 'od gsal ni 'chi ba'i tshe snang mched thob gsum thim pa'i tha ma de nyid dang*/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi mtshams su 'char ba'i 'od gsal de nyid do// lam gyi 'od gsal ni de nyid nyams su blangs pas rtogs pa de ka yin la/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal ni 'chi ba 'od gsal chos skur sangs rgyas pa'o// gnyis pa nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ chos drug dril ba rdo rje'i mgur las/ gnyid dang rmi lam bar zhig na// gti mug chos sku'i ngo bo can// brjod med 'od gsal bde ba'i nyams// rjes la 'od gsal rgya yis thebs// rmi lam 'od gsal 'thug po nyid// ming yang 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag zer// sems skye med du rtogs sam lo tsā ba// zhes gsungs pa la'ang gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ 'od gsal mi zin pa'i rgyu rnams spang dgos te/ dam tshig nyams pa/ bla ma dang gsang sngags la mos gus chung ba/ dngos po la mngon zhen ches pa/ grib phog pa/ kun+da nyams pa/ rnam g.yeng che ba/ 'dun pa zhan pa rnams mi zin pa'i rgyu yin pas spang*/ zin pa'i thabs ni rdor sems sgom zhing yig brgya bzla/ bla ma la dbang zhu zhing dam tshig gso/ mos gus bya zhing maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol ba gdab/ yi dam dang chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul/ spong dag btang zhing tshe 'di'i 'khri ba bcad/ grib sel dang khrus bya/ dben par mtshams bsdams shing snang shas spang*/ de dag thams cad kyi tshe 'od gsal zin par gsol ba gdab/

bsku mnye bya zhing bza' btung bcud can bsten/ spyod lam dal bar bya/ khyad par srung ma rnams la mi shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma chang gis bran pa dbul/ spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms nas 'od gsal zin par gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi 'od gsal 'dzin pa la gnyis/ 'dzin pa dang bogs dbyung ba'o// dang po ni/ tho rangs sam nam langs kar sngas mtho ba la seng ge'i nyal stabs gzhogs g.yas phab/ lag g.yas 'gram pa g.yas la brten/ lag g.yon brla g.yon pa'i steng du brkyang rkang pa gnyis brtsegs te brkyangs pa cung zad bskums nas bzung yang rung*/ lus gnad tsog pu byas kyang rung ste/ de gnyis 'dzin gang bde bya/ gnyid kyi snang mched thob gsum thim pa'i mthar rmi lam rmi ba'i snga rol der 'od gsal cis kyang zin par bya'o snyam du bsams la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i snying ga'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus su pad+ma sngon po dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po sku chung la dod pa/ 'od 'phro ba/ shel gong lta bu phyi gsal nang gsal bla ma'i sku'i 'od kyis rang lus phyi nang med pa mar me ltar gsal bar bsgoms la nyal/ des ma zin na bla ma'i thugs kar pad+ma sngon po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po 'od zer 'phro ba zhig bsams la nyal/ des kyang ma zin na ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig gi bsdu rim gyis 'dzin pa ni| ril 'dzin byed na rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po la sems gtad nas rlung kha sbyor ci rigs pa bzung la hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang lhar gsal ba'i sku lus stod smad nas me long la ha btab pa ltar hūm̐ la bsdus/ hūm̐ yang nā da'i bar du bsdus/ nā da yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas de'i shul du sems rtse gcig tu gtad la rlung bzung zhing gnyid do| |yang rjes gzhig byed na rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po gsal btab rlung bzung hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/

snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas 'od du zhu ba bcud kyi sems can la thim| de 'od du zhu ba rang lhar gsal ba la thim/ lha'i stod smad nas 'od du zhu ba hūm̐ sogs ril 'dzin ltar byas la gnyid do// de thams cad kyis ma zin na mtshams dam par bcad/ zhag gsum gnyid bcag /bzhi pa'i nub mo bur chang bag tsam btung zhing bla ma la gsol ba btab la/ rang gi snying gar pad nyi'i gdan la bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'od zer 'phro ba'i thugs kar thig le sngon po yungs 'bru tsam 'od 'phro ba snum zhing 'dril ba de kho na la sems gtad/ rnam rtog byung na rnam rtog de thams cad kyang 'od zer gyi rnam pas thig le la thim par dmigs la nyal bas nges par zin par 'gyur ro// de'ang grogs yod na grogs kyis 'od gsal e zin ltar bcug la rang gis 'dzin/ 'od gsal zin pa'i rtags su gnyid 'jam la dbugs rngam pa bde zhing bzhin gyi mdangs gsal bar 'byung*/ de ltar mi 'dug na gnyid sad du bcug la slar 'dzin/ grogs med na rang gis gnyid yang yang sad la 'dzin pa gal che'o/ de ltar zin pa'i tshe/ rab kyis brgyal thabs su ma song bar yul snang phra rags thams cad 'gags shing*/ snang med kyi sems ngos bzung med pa nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bu rang gis kyang ngo shes pa der 'dzin med pa zhig byung na gnyid 'thug gi 'od gsal dngos gzhi yin/ 'bring gis gnyid 'thug nag thum tsam song yang de sangs 'phral rmi lam du mi 'khrul bar snang ba phra rags 'gags pa'i sems gsal stong seng nge ba de srab mo'i 'od gsal yin/ tha mas de dag gang yang ma nges par rmi lam yang ma rmis par nyi zla mar me'i 'od lta bu gsal nyams yod bzhin pa sems lhan ne gnas pa zhig 'byung ba ni nyams kyi 'od gsal yin no// gnyis pa de dag bogs dbyung ba ni/ lus gnad sogs snga ma ltar la rang lhar gsal ba tsam la rlung dmigs gzhan mi bsgom par gnyid kyi thim rim ngos bzung nas 'od gsal la 'jug par bya ste/
